steps.code:
# Iterate through songs to find one released in 2020
access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2pvLmJhbGxAZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyNzQxfQ.jPVDWwlCZN6aeUOFGCAUa_xI89PP8T9Be_hT4WIBe8M'
found_song = None
for sid in sorted(all_song_ids):
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid, access_token=access_token)
    if 'release_date' in song:
        year = int(song['release_date'][:4])
        if year == 2020:
            found_song = song
            print(f"Found song: {song['title']} (ID: {sid}) released {song['release_date']}")
            break
if found_song is None:
    print("No song from 2020 found in playlists")
else:
    # Play this song
    result = apis.spotify.play_music(song_id=found_song['song_id'], access_token=access_token)
    print(result)
